help.labels generate:
usage: ccil labels generate [-h] [--recipe RECIPE] [--config CONFIG]
                            [--set KEY=VALUE]

Run offline label generation: data.prepare -> transition.fit -> labels.generate.

required:  data.path, generation.method (via --recipe, --config, or --set)
outputs:   one run directory per stage under run.output_dir; labels in
           labels-generate-*/labels/candidates.npz (accepted and rejected rows)
           and a report in its metrics.json
resume:    a stage whose run directory is already complete is reused
optional:  no extra dependencies (core install)
exit:      0 success; 2 invalid configuration, data, or stage failure

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --recipe RECIPE  named recipe in src/ccil/recipes/
  --config CONFIG  user configuration file (YAML)
  --set KEY=VALUE  override one parameter; repeatable
help.pipeline integrated:
usage: ccil pipeline integrated [-h] [--recipe RECIPE] [--config CONFIG]
                                [--set KEY=VALUE]

Run the integrated pipeline: data.prepare -> representation.fit ->
transition.fit -> labels.generate -> policy.train -> policy.evaluate.

The reference components (PCA representation, linear or mean-action policy,
offline action-error evaluation) stand in for M5 image encoders and real
policies; they claim no image-CCIL parity.

required:  data.path, generation.method, representation.kind=pca, representation.dim
outputs:   one run directory per stage under run.output_dir; the policy in
           policy-train-*/checkpoints/policy.npz and its evaluation in
           policy-evaluate-*/metrics.json
resume:    complete stages are reused; changing only policy.* reuses stages 1-4
optional:  no extra dependencies (core install)
exit:      0 success; 2 invalid configuration, data, or stage failure

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --recipe RECIPE  named recipe in src/ccil/recipes/
  --config CONFIG  user configuration file (YAML)
  --set KEY=VALUE  override one parameter; repeatable
